elevenlabs-dialogue.description: A conversation between several ElevenLabs voices in one audio file (Eleven v4 by default). The script input is one line per turn, "<voice name>: <text>", for example "Rachel: Hello there." then "Adam: Hi!". The speaker is everything before the first colon. Use names from the person's ElevenLabs voice library; they match ignoring case, and a voice ID works in place of a name. Before the paid call Nebula looks the names up in their voices (a free call). A name that matches no voice, or more than one, stops the run without generating, and the error lists the candidate voices with their IDs. Up to 10 different voices and 2,000 characters per run. Audio tags such as [whispering] go in the text.
elevenlabs-dialogue.capabilityNote: Write one line per turn as Name: text, with voice names from your ElevenLabs voices (for example Rachel: Hi there. then Adam: Hey!). Nebula looks the names up before generating. If a name matches no voice, or more than one, the run stops and lists the voices with their IDs; you can write a voice ID in place of the name. Up to 10 voices and 2,000 characters per run.

jev-decide.description: Judge, classify or score text and images with one typed question: yes/no, pick one option, or rate on a scale. Returns the answer, its probability, confidence and a pass / fail / unsure verdict. Also a gate: whatever is wired into Through comes out of On Pass or On Fail, and the nodes on the other branch are skipped. TypeSafe Jev makes decisions only, no text generation. Image input is experimental.

TypeSafe Jev makes decisions only, no text generation. Experimental at TypeSafe.
